verdicts.note: Repeated explicit enforcement statements across the site and her own VoteWA statement: violent-crime convictions and 'more focus' on stolen cars and retail theft [S1][S3], 'no patience for crime of any kind' and 'holding criminals accountable' [S8]. Every stated position sits on pole A, which supports high confidence in the direction. -1 rather than -2 is right because she states no position on diversion, bail, treatment or charging thresholds (dossier line 75), and Leavitt's endorsement quote describes a 'compassion' approach [S5].

Career prosecutor since 2006 and chief criminal deputy since 2024, running as the retiring incumbent's chosen successor [S2][S5][S8]. Robnett's 'next-generation leadership' line in the statement [S8] does not make her a renewal candidate; -1 (not -2) reflects that she has not held elected office.
One accountability pledge, 'show you what the office delivers for every dollar', with no call for new spending [S3]. A single short line, so low is honest and keeps it out of the alignment math.

S3 criticizes the rising decline-to-charge rate and falling felony filings, and his statement cites the communication gap with law enforcement [S8]. Both lean toward enforcement but are framed as management failures, and he states no position on diversion, bail or sentencing. The basis does not lean on the Republican Party or police-union endorsements [S4][S5]. -1 at medium holds.

28 years and seven elected terms on the Superior Court, presiding judge and statewide court-administration roles [S2][S8], and the statement pitches 'Competent, Experienced Leadership' [S8]. That is the proven-record profile even though he has not worked in the prosecutor's office. Medium is right because the tenure is campaign-sourced and was not verified against court records.

'The core failure is management' and performance data should drive strategy [S3]; the statement says backlog delays shift jail, medical and legal costs onto taxpayers and pledges accountability and reorganization, not new programs [S8]. The one counterweight is a call to 'advocate for increased funding to retain experienced staff' [S1], a narrow staffing request. -1 at medium holds.
